name: Real Masala Mixed Fruit Juice
ingredients_raw: Water, Sugar, Concentrated Mixed Fruit Juice (4%) [From Orange, Apple, Guava, Apricot, Mango, Banana, Passion Fruit, Lime, Lemon, Mango Pulp (3.3%), Acidity Regulator (INS 330), lodized Salt, Black Salt, Stabilizers (INS 440, INS 466, INS 418), Antioxidant (INS 300), Spices And Condiments (0.1%) [Chilli Powder, Cumin, Coriander, Black Pepper and Turmeric], Colours [INS 160 a (ii) & (iii)] and Flavours (Natural & Nature Identical Flavouring Substances). THIS CONTAINS 23.3% MIXED FRUIT JUICE CONTENT.
